title: How to Run a Windows Security Quick Scan
overview: This article supports the Run a Windows Security Quick Scan step in the Computer Running Slowly workflow. It explains how to perform a Microsoft Defender Quick Scan to identify common malware that may be affecting system performance before continuing with additional troubleshooting.
checklist: Save any open work before beginning.
Select Quick scan and allow the scan to complete without interruption.
Review any detected threats or recommended actions.
If threats are found, follow your organization's malware remediation procedures before continuing.
Record the scan results and return to the troubleshooting workflow.
common_indicators: Windows Security reports that virus definitions require updating.

quiz.question: What should you verify after completing a Windows Security Quick Scan?
answers: Review the scan results and record any detected threats.
Close Windows Security without reviewing the results.
quiz.correct_answer: Review the scan results and record any detected threats.
